name: SwingArena
description: SwingArena is a competitive evaluation framework for Large Language Models that simulates real-world software development workflows by pairing LLMs as submitters and reviewers, using continuous integration pipelines to validate code patches. It supports multiple programming languages and addresses long-context challenges with a retrieval-augmented code generation module.
reputation: A very recent research benchmark for agentic code workflows that is not yet broadly adopted, but it is notable for evaluating submitter-reviewer interactions with CI-based validation.
notes: Uses real-world GitHub issues and models collaborative software development with submitter and reviewer roles; retrieval-augmented code generation module handles long contexts.
